title: TimelineFrame
description: One renderable frame of a simulation's timeline — what the 3D renderer consumes to animate a scenario over time (architecture.md §7/§8). Not implemented by the renderer yet.

state.description: The SimulationState (or a render-ready projection of it) for this timestep.

is_key_event.description: True if this frame represents a notable event worth jumping to directly (architecture.md §6 playback controls).
